turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Let me know if I am too quiet.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: You are fine, thank you for asking.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What brings you to the clinic today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I came because of my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Did it begin suddenly or slowly?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: This morning, while I was making tea.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How would you describe what you feel in your chest?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is more of a dull ache.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it move into your arms or up toward your neck?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I feel it in my jaw sometimes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does doing chores around the house set it off?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Only when I hurry.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you taken anything for it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nothing really helps.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is your breathing affected?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No trouble breathing at all.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you drenched or clammy during the episodes?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you felt faint or dizzy?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I almost passed out in the kitchen.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any heart problems in your close relatives?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nobody that I remember.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have any history of diabetes, blood pressure problems or cholesterol problems, or do you smoke?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure, and I have an irregular heartbeat. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have a history of heart surgery or stents?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Bypass surgery, a long time ago.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Which pills do you take regularly?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Lisinopril and Apixaban.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: To finish, here is the plan. First, get a heart tracing and a blood test today. Second, bring your medicine bottles to your next visit. Third, take one baby aspirin every morning. Can you repeat the plan in your own words for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will get the heart tracing and the blood test today, bring my medicine bottles next time and take one baby aspirin each morning.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Anything else on your mind?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Okay, that is everything for today. Take care.
